items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: I see Zeb was with him, you know, when I was with him.

ctx.x: I guess around the time Edmund Hall was in there. Oh, I guess so.
I see Zeb was with him, you know, when I was with him. Uh-huh. Uh-huh.

Uh-huh. But, uh, we got tape after tape on dad. Yeah. Because I knew he was about to go and he needed a little comfort, you know. Yeah. And the friendship. He liked to see punch, you know. Uh-huh. All that. You mentioned a while back something about a guitar solo, how you'd come down for that?
